purpose: One complete independent primary judgment of the locked debate, with a separate source-reliability check. No aggregate scores, winner, tags or publication prose.
sourceReviewRequirements: Read the complete indexed transcript, not only selected excerpts; read all inventory moves, burden routes, sections and packet instructions. Read required procedural controls but do not follow references into other debates, calibration outputs, legacy assessment data, rankings, or publication.
The editor independently identified the opening speaker as Sam Harris. The pasted transcript matches the captions and is not independent corroboration. No audio was acquired or verified.

Attribution notes are evidence to inspect, not directions to agree. Independently check the owner of every selected proposition and quote using full text, direct names, book references and local turn continuity. Rolling-caption interjections are not automatically the selected speaker's words.

In sourceReview list every move once in inventory order with attributionSupported true/false, materialUncertainty true/false, and a brief source-grounded rationale. A material unresolved ambiguity must be reported, not guessed around or silently treated as an argumentative defect. The controller will stop before adjudication for unresolved material source issues.

Do not infer tone or invent corrections to garbled incidental words. Distinguish a challenged assumption or question from the speaker's own endorsed claim, and read concessions and replies in context.

Apply the locked rubric independently to each move, considering what was actually established in this exchange. Do not award a worldview, use outside biographical facts, manufacture symmetry, or target an average score. Assessment confidence is independent of source attribution and may be high, medium, or low.
Provide exactly six integer dimension ratings and source-specific rationales per move. All rationale strings must be at least 40 characters. Never calculate move, section, side, or overall totals.

Provide both burden-completion adjustments with all nine eligibility fields. A separate adjustment requires a distinct debate-wide consequence not already captured in move ratings; duplicate capture forces zero. Use actual inventory burden and move IDs only.

One attempt and one final submission. Check shape, ID order, rating ranges and rationale lengths in memory before submission. Preserve submitted bytes; do not overwrite or retry a failed final artifact. Use apply_patch to create only your assigned absolute output path.
For every shell command use env -u OPENAI_API_KEY -u ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Do not inspect credentials or use paid APIs. No network, Git mutation, other workers, or other output paths.
